notes: world-state-store.ts now imports WorldStateV2 and assertWorldStateV2 instead of src/lib/world/world-state.ts.
The controller hides the writable Zustand setState surface and exposes getState, getCommitHash, getCommittedCommandIds, replaceWorldState, and subscribeDomain for the v2 atomic commit boundary.
replaceWorldState now requires AtomicWorldCommitMetadata, rejects non-sequential revisions, stale previousCommitHash values, mismatched commit revisions, and duplicate command ids.
The existing v1-oriented store selector tests were migrated to v2 fixtures so repo-wide TypeScript still passes after the store boundary replacement.
A focused 11-3 test verifies committed revision advance, stale replacement rejection, atomic store type compatibility, and direct snapshot mutation rejection.
